layouts.name: Orange Pads / Orange Baskets
layouts.description: Short orange pads, orange (A) baskets: the UDisc layout of the same name (par 57, 4,075 ft). Hole 3, 7-11, 15 have no A path on UDisc, so the B pin is used there. UDisc path lengths sum to 4,075 ft, par 57.

layouts.name: Blue Pads / Orange Baskets
layouts.description: Long blue pads to the orange (A) baskets (par 57, 5,495 ft, from UDisc path lengths; B pin where no A path exists). UDisc path lengths sum to 5,495 ft, par 57.
